prompt: Photorealistic high aerial drone shot looking down at a vast empty stone plaza at golden hour sunset. Two colossal gateways stand side by side like giant doors. On the left: Gwanghwamun, the main gate of Gyeongbokgung Palace in Seoul, scaled up to skyscraper size, its central arched doorway open and glowing with warm golden light. On the right: the base of Lotte World Tower, the tall slender glass supertall skyscraper of Seoul, with a giant open doorway cut into its foot glowing cool electric blue light. A huge crowd of hundreds of ordinary modern people in casual everyday clothes walks away from the camera across the plaza, splitting into two streams, one stream entering the palace gate and the other entering the tower doorway. Long shadows, warm orange sky versus cool blue glow, strong color contrast.

Surreal but photorealistic aerial drone photograph of Seoul at dusk. In the middle of Gwanghwamun Square, two impossible giant doors stand next to each other: a gigantic traditional Korean palace gate of Gyeongbokgung with curved tiled roof and open wooden doors spilling warm golden light, and beside it a gigantic futuristic doorway shaped like the glass base of Lotte World Tower spilling bright cyan neon light. Hundreds of tiny ordinary people in jeans and t-shirts walk from the bottom of the frame toward the doors and divide into two lines, half going into the palace gate, half going into the futuristic tower door. Wide composition, both doors fully visible, dramatic sky.
